noise_definition: Apply PennyLane DepolarizingChannel(p1) independently to the acted-on wire immediately after every RY and RZ. Immediately after each CNOT(q, q+1), apply DepolarizingChannel(p2) to q and then to q+1 (independent local two-wire-equivalent depolarization; no correlated two-qubit Pauli term). Do not noise the amplitude-embedding state preparation or final basis-change gates.
basis_measurement_definition: Measure all five qubits simultaneously in each of the X, Y, and Z product bases; X uses H before computational measurement; Y uses adjoint(S) then H; each basis uses the same shot count. XYZ features are the per-qubit signed sample means concatenated in qubit-major X,Y,Z order.
